name: Going Your Own Way
source: Going Your Own Way is a visual novel that allows you make choices that will help a young man trying to understand his place in the world while dealing with the recent ending of a long-term relationship, the challenges of modern dating, and a toxic workplace.
translation: 《Going Your Own Way》是一部视觉小说。玩家将通过一次次抉择，帮助一名年轻男子在刚刚结束一段长跑恋情、直面现代约会重重挑战并应付压抑有毒的职场环境之余，努力找寻自己在世间的容身之处。
